library_preparation_preflight.summary: reactor-netty-http 1.3.0 pulls in Netty 4.2.7.Final, whose CleanerJava25 frees direct buffers via Arena.ofShared(); Native Image disables shared-arena support by default, so the generated test will fail with 'Support for Arena.ofShared is not active' unless the build enables it.
risks: -H:+SharedArenaSupport is still experimental in GraalVM 25.0.x and is documented upstream as incompatible with -H:+VectorAPISupport; no conflict was observed in the lettuce-core precedent, but local Native Image verification should confirm this build's default flags don't enable Vector API support.

If a later reactor-netty-http version in this family upgrades its transitive Netty dependency to 4.2.8.Final or newer, the flag becomes unnecessary (Netty will auto-detect and fall back) but should remain harmless to keep.
